name: chevron-up
description: A balanced upward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: This is the exact vertical reflection of Chevron Down about y=12. Mirrored 45-degree arms meet at 12,8.75, with endpoints at 5.5,15.25 and 18.5,15.25. Native bounds are centered at 12,12. Regular visible margins are 4.65 horizontally and 7.9 vertically. One continuous centerline avoids doubled joins. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft and tray geometry are retained. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review.
